B1.label: SFT + original GRPO
B1.purpose: Baseline RL on independently sampled tasks

B2.label: GRPO + the same paired data
B2.purpose: Does pairing the training data itself help?

B3.label: RP-GRPO eta > 0 + the same paired data
B3.purpose: Does the paired utility add benefit?

frozen_comparisons: same exact base, tokenizer and initial SFT adapter
same schema, prompts, data partitions, scorer, and inference budget
B2/B3/LOO use the same paired task scheduler and seeds
B1 samples independent tasks from the same eligible pool; no unreported extra data
count actual generated tokens, tool calls and elapsed wall time; not only update steps
environment logical cost is a declared proxy, not measured cloud billing
B0 original model actions and each rule intervention must be recorded separately

evaluation.required_before_generalization_claim: Create independent task/source/experiment families before tuning; freeze the protocol and hold out their labels.
evaluation.statistical_unit: original task/source/experiment family; not tool steps or G-squared utility cells

scientific_scope: The RL environment implements exact-source extraction and finite snapshot statistics. Semantic or causal labels require an independently specified task and scorer.

distribution.initial_sft_adapter: External or locally trained adapter required for RL
distribution.final_rl_weights: To be added in a future release
